# iosxe_voice_service_voip (Data Source)

This data source can read the Voice Service VoIP configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_voice_service_voip" "example" {
  type = "voip"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String)

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `address_hiding` (Boolean) Address hiding (SIP-SIP)
- `allow_connections_sip_to_sip` (Boolean) to-type sip
- `dtmf_interworking` (String) Dtmf Interworking
- `emergency` (String) List of Emergency Numbers

- `media_bulk_stats` (Boolean) Retrieve bulk statistics is enabled
